summary: Central retinal artery and vein branches: four arcades from the disc around the macula; arteries lighter and narrower than veins.

vein_calibre.note: Main vein branch width within one disc diameter of the disc margin.

artery_vein_ratio.note: Artery over vein calibre, about 2:3; lower in hypertensive narrowing.

artery_calibre.note: Main artery branch width near the disc.

arcade_separation.note: Vertical distance between the superior and inferior temporal arcades above and below the fovea; render calibration (low).

branch_seed.note: Seed of the generated branching pattern: each patient has their own vessels; render parameter.

artery_colour.note: Linear; arteries are bright red. Render calibration (low).

vein_colour.note: Linear; veins are darker, purplish red. Render calibration (low).

artery_reflex.note: Central light reflex along the arteries, about a third of their width; render calibration (low).

clinical.notes: Fundus coordinates: millimetres on the retina from the foveal centre, +x temporal, +y up, the same for both eyes (the renderer mirrors the left eye).

provenance.source: Kanski's Clinical Ophthalmology, 9th ed.; Hubbard et al., Ophthalmology 106:2269 (1999) for vessel calibres and the artery to vein ratio
